functions.name: create-customer
functions.description: Create a customer and receive the IDs of its default group and default-group policy. Optionally copy settings from an existing policy.

name.description: Name of the new customer, preserved without trimming.

basePolicyId.description: Existing policy whose settings are copied into the customer's default-group policy; omit to use provider default creation behavior.

FunctionInput_zorus_createcustomer.description: Customer name and optional policy whose settings are copied during creation.

id.description: UUID of the newly created customer.

name.description: Provider-returned customer name; preserve null and omit if absent.

FunctionOutput_zorus_createcustomer.description: Created customer and the provider-returned identifiers of its default resources.

tags.instructions: Use this for a new customer, not to update an existing one. Obtain an optional base policy ID from `list-policies`. Save the returned customer and default-group IDs for `create-group` and `create-deployment-token`. Creation is not safe to replay blindly: check `list-customers` after an uncertain result.

id.description: UUID of the new deployment token.

name.description: Provider-returned token name, including an automatically generated name; null or omission preserved.

token.description: Secret deployment-token value returned by Zorus; null or omission means no usable secret was returned and is not an empty credential.

groupId.description: Owning group UUID; omitted if absent upstream.

groupName.description: Owning group name; preserve null or omission.

customerId.description: Owning customer UUID; omitted if absent upstream.

customerName.description: Owning customer name; preserve null or omission.

tags.instructions: Obtain groupId from `list-groups`, `get-group`, or defaultGroupId from `create-customer`. Omit name to let Zorus generate a unique name. Treat the returned token as a secret. This creates a new credential; do not blindly retry after an uncertain outcome.

functions.name: create-group
functions.description: Create a customer group, optionally copying settings from an existing policy into its generated policy.

name.description: New group name, passed unchanged without trimming.

customerId.description: UUID of the customer that will own the new group.

basePolicyId.description: Policy whose settings are copied into the new group's policy; omission generates an empty policy using global settings.

FunctionInput_zorus_creategroup.description: Customer, unchanged group name, and optional policy to copy for the new group.

name.description: Group name echoed from the successful request, not a fetched group record.

FunctionOutput_zorus_creategroup.description: Acknowledgement of successful group creation without a returned group identifier.

tags.instructions: Get customerId from `list-customers` or `create-customer`, and an optional basePolicyId from `list-policies`. Without a base policy, Zorus generates an empty policy that uses global policy settings. The API does not return a group ID; use `list-groups` to locate it afterward. Do not blindly replay creation after an uncertain result.

The acknowledgement does not prove the remote agent has applied the change; inspect `get-endpoint` afterward if needed.
